selected_evidence.requirement: TCP 8081 is reachable only through loopback
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, ss showed only 127.0.0.1:8081; loopback returned HTTP 200 with expected content, while 10.100.110.10:8081 refused the connection.
The service was enabled and active initially and remained enabled and active after reboot.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 03408ac4-bfe4-4151-98bd-1966b0a205af; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; the recovered boot ID changed to 331a9791-6794-43a5-a7e6-47d829a23381; final checks proved system, service, content, loopback access, and external-interface isolation recovered.

getenforce

if [ -e /var/www/loopback-8081/index.html ]; then sed -n '1,40p' /var/www/loopback-8081/index.html; else printf '%s\n' 'content absent'; fi

content absent

commands.command:
install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /var/www/loopback-8081 printf '%s\n' '' '' 'Loopback Service' '

Loopback-only service

node1 TCP 8081

' '' > /var/www/loopback-8081/index.html chown root:root /var/www/loopback-8081/index.html chmod 0644 /var/www/loopback-8081/index.html restorecon -RF /var/www/loopback-8081

printf '%s\n' '[Unit]' 'Description=Loopback-only HTTP service on TCP 8081' 'After=network.target' '' '[Service]' 'Type=simple' 'ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 8081 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory /var/www/loopback-8081' 'DynamicUser=yes' 'Restart=on-failure' 'RestartSec=2s' 'NoNewPrivileges=yes' 'PrivateTmp=yes' 'ProtectSystem=strict' 'ProtectHome=yes' 'ProtectKernelTunables=yes' 'ProtectKernelModules=yes' 'ProtectControlGroups=yes' 'RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET' 'CapabilityBoundingSet=' 'LockPersonality=yes' '' '[Install]' 'WantedBy=multi-user.target' > /etc/systemd/system/loopback-web.service
chown root:root /etc/systemd/system/loopback-web.service
chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/loopback-web.service
restorecon /etc/systemd/system/loopback-web.service
systemctl daemon-reload
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/loopback-web.service

systemctl enable --now loopback-web.service
systemctl is-enabled loopback-web.service
systemctl is-active loopback-web.service

cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
systemctl is-enabled loopback-web.service
systemctl is-active loopback-web.service
ss -ltnp '( sport = :8081 )'
printf 'loopback_http_status='
curl --noproxy '*' --silent --show-error --max-time 5 --output /run/loopback-body --write-out '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8081/
printf 'loopback_body='
tr -d '\n' < /run/loopback-body
printf '\n'
curl --noproxy '*' --silent --show-error --max-time 3 --output /run/external-body "http://$NODE_IP:8081/" 2>/run/external-error
external_rc=$?
if [ "$external_rc" -eq 0 ]; then printf 'external_access=UNEXPECTEDLY_REACHABLE target=%s\n' "$NODE_IP"; cat /run/external-body; exit 1; fi
printf 'external_access=blocked target=%s curl_exit=%s\n' "$NODE_IP" "$external_rc"
sed -n '1,3p' /run/external-error
rm -f /run/loopback-body /run/external-body /run/external-error
